caption: A skateboarder rolling along a flat path lowers his back foot and drags it on the ground, and the board slows and comes to a stop.

sa.check: A skateboarder rolls along a flat path.
He lowers his back foot to the ground.
He drags the foot along the ground.
The board slows and comes to a stop.
It is the back foot that is lowered.
The foot touches down first and the slowing follows.

pc.expect: The slowing begins when the foot touches the ground and goes on while it drags.
pc.fail: The board keeps its speed while the foot plainly drags; or the board slows before the foot reaches the ground; or the foot drags and the board speeds up.

pc.expect: The board keeps a straight line as it slows and stops smoothly with the rider still on it.
pc.fail: The board veers sharply while the foot drags; or it stops dead with a jolt and throws the rider; or it rolls backward after stopping.

pc.expect: Nothing else acts on the board, and once stopped it stays stopped.
pc.fail: The board slows with the foot never touching the ground; or it sets off again after stopping; or it speeds up on the flat with no push.

pc.expect: The dragging foot stays on the ground and the board stays on its wheels.
pc.fail: The foot hovers above the ground while the board slows; or the board lifts off the path; or the rider floats above the board.

pc.expect: The rider and the board keep their number and shape, and nothing passes through anything.
pc.fail: The foot passes through the deck or the ground; or a limb detaches or vanishes; or the board passes through the path.

pc.expect: The rider's clothing, the board and the path stay the same.
pc.fail: The rider's clothing changes colour; or the board's deck changes graphic; or the path's surface changes between frames.

note: Friction scene: the rider is kept because his foot is the brake. Stance, style and how he balances are not judged; only when the foot touches down and how the board's speed responds.
